correctness.rationale: The prime-power quotient is rho_p(a)=(1+p^a)/sum_{d|a}p^d (with rho_p(0)=1); rho_p(1)>1 and rho_p(a)<1 for a>=2. Disjoint odd valuation cylinders for p<=19, conditioned on odd parity and squarefree at all larger primes, have exact mass W_o=31076642675170427132493824/35968987080950832137604375 and 18058 selected vectors. The Euler-product factor and pi<22/7 yield strict liminf>17/20. Selected even cylinders have 32591 vectors, mass W_e=38646621072482317819/148330460379458857500 >13/50 and small-prime ratio<11/12. The infinite tail product T is controlled by a convergent 100th moment; prime-product rational bound B<1/70 and Markov give even failure density >897/3500, hence success limsup <3/4. Checked convergence of conditional divisor-sum moment by g(q)=O(1/q) and finite-modulus CRT, not inferred from finite patterns. Independent code rederived both masses/counts and moment bound.
correctness.risk: Only liminf/limsup bounds; not exact parity-conditioned limiting densities.
